comingLast.roast: somebody sit on him, the presso is not for another hour
with 6 to play and 8 in hand, boring golf is beautiful golf
hovering 9 above the double blue - altitude: uncomfortable
10 above Briggs - one man's cushion is another man's target
11 clear of the worst seat in the house
in on a cushion of 12 - refreshing the board between sips
12 points of breathing room at 1.4 a hole - shallow breaths
his round is over, his sweating is not - 13 above the line
clear of Briggs by 13 - nobody tell him, he plays worse informed
cushion of 14 over Briggs - the bar has him at even money
